property_summary: For any caller with zero credit, withdrawAll must complete without reverting (no external call is made); the mutant always enters the branch and issues a zero-value call, which reverts when the caller cannot receive ETH (e.g. a plain contract with no payable receive), breaking the rule.
change_summary: Replace the guard `if (oCredit > 0)` with `if (oCredit >= 0)` so the withdrawal branch executes even when the caller has zero credit.
